spec: specs.md §14.2, §17.2; conformance/models/README.md, flaw 1 and its limit
description: What the row of a copy records when a reprise finds it at its name, however long after a crash or a disk lost, and whether it is recorded unverified: from what the part was when it was verified, what the job recorded of its change time right after the rename, in a commit of its own, and what the reprise's look finds. With that record, a change time other than the one recorded is a write since the rename: the row is the part's, which the next look finds moved, an edit. Without it, the crash having come between the rename and that commit, nothing tells a write that moved only the change time from the rename's: the row takes the change time found when nothing else moved, and the copy is unverified when that is not the one it was verified with. A job an earlier version verified recorded no look: what is found, unverified.

cases.note: the change time recorded right after the rename, found again: nothing was written since, and the row takes it

a write since the rename that kept the size, the times, the mode and the owner moved only the change time, past the one recorded: the row is the part's, whose change time the next look finds moved, an edit
a write since the rename of another size: the part's
a chmod since the rename: the part's, and the next look finds a change of metadata
a write between the rename and the look the record was taken from, of another size, and nothing since: the part's, as the commit would have recorded it
a rename within a clock tick of the verification: the change time recorded is the part's, found again
a change time found earlier than the one recorded, as no user sets it back: still not the one recorded, the part's
no creation time on that filesystem, and the change time recorded found again

no record, the crash having come between the rename and its commit: the change time moved past the verified one, by the rename or by a write too; the row takes it, as nothing else moved, and the copy is unverified
no record, and the change time the part was verified with: the rename came within its clock tick, and nothing moved since
no record, a write of another size: the part's, which the next look finds moved, and unverified
no record, a chown: the part's, and unverified
no record, on a filesystem with no creation time: as above
a job an earlier version verified recorded no look: what is found, unverified, as nothing says what was verified
